structure_changes.text: Trustees' CPC and Treatment committees combined (1998); 'Special Needs-Accessibilities' added (2009); 'Special Needs' dropped (Nov 2015).
"Additional" Regional Forums discontinued (the last was Southwest, Denver, June 2016).
The Conference committee is printed as "Conference Agenda" until 2018 and "Agenda" from 2019.
Conference Committee on Grapevine becomes "Grapevine and La Viña"; trustees' "International Conventions/Regional Forums" wording.
Virtual Conferences (2020: four days, essential business only; 2021: full week online).
Equitable Distribution of Workload (EDW): three-year trial from 2021, adopted 2024.
Area 48 renamed from Hudson/Mohawk/Berkshire to Northeast New York. Proposals for virtual areas: no action.
GSB chair resigned; interim chairs Jimmy D. (to April 2023) and Mike L. (to April 2024).
GSB vice-chairs and secretary chosen by Third Legacy Procedure; first Class B chair seat (Scott H.), so the board has 22 trustees.
Committee draws rebalanced toward an even mix of first- and second-year delegates.
Prioritized committee-selection criteria; PAI deadline Sept 30; workshops replaced by Conference Inventory sessions.
No action on a Conference digital committee (still 13 committees); Conference committee chairs move to the Q4 (Oct/Nov) board weekend; talks on linguistic and virtual areas continue.
No new areas and no regional boundary changes: 93 areas in every roster.

delegate_chair_rules.text: The Conference delegate chair for next year is chosen at this year's Conference from the first-year delegates, by lot ("from the hat"). Since about 2022 it happens at the delegates-only dinner after the committees have elected their chairs and alternates, from the delegates not yet chosen (2024 report p. 47: "electing the General Service Conference Delegate chair from the remaining delegates (not yet selected for Committee or alt chair) remains a viable procedure"). Before then it was drawn at the Tuesday Delegates Only meeting, before the committee elections, so the 2018 (Ben B., Grapevine alternate) and 2021 (Donny M., IC/RF alternate) delegate chairs were also committee alternates. Proposals to change the method (2023: one nominee per region, two by lot; 2025: committee nominees and a Third Legacy vote) were floor actions the Conference declined to consider — not Advisory Actions (2023 report p. 50; 2025 report p. 53). An alternate delegate chair is printed only for 2010, 2018 and 2019. The U.S./Canada alternation 2021-2027 is a pattern, not a rule.
